info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension, trimmed to the parameters anari-cycles actually reads. Parameters removed here are unimplemented (uniform instance 'color'/'attribute0..3'); they will be restored when the corresponding feature tasks land. Keep info.name equal to the official extension name so introspection still advertises it.
